content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** (rule MFN — most-favoured-nation obligations burdening Customer)

- The agreement contains no MFN obligation on Bluefly. Targeted searches for "no less favo(u)rable", "most favored", "favourable/favorable", "best price", "discount" and "any other customer" returned no hits.
- § 4.1 Charges (p0052) is purely mechanical: Charges are specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, with no requirement that we extend IBM any terms given to third parties or match competing offers.
- § 14.16 Freedom of Action (p0200) — "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others." — is the inverse of an MFN burden and confirms no exclusivity/best-terms tie.

This sits at the **preferred** position (no MFN obligation on Customer). Noted for information only, and not a deviation: IBM does not grant us an MFN either, but the playbook does not require one, so no redline was proposed.
